observations: Photo 0: black compact camera with lens cap on; "Nikon" on lens cap and body; strap reads "Nikon" and "COOLPIX"; white foam background.
Photo 1: same camera from another angle; "COOLPIX" and "Nikon" on strap; "Nikon" on body; lens cap on.
Photo 2: different black compact camera held in a hand; lens ring reads "SONY", "Carl Zeiss", and zoom markings; no Nikon branding visible.

claims.claim: Nikon mini professional photo and video camera for beginners
claims.evidence: Photos 0 and 1 show Nikon Coolpix branding, but photo 2 shows a Sony camera with a Carl Zeiss lens, so the Nikon claim does not match all the photos.

risks.risk: Wrong item or mixed photos: the listing may be for a Nikon, a Sony, or neither, and the two brands have very different resale values.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the actual camera for sale showing the model number and branding.
risks.if_unproven: as an unidentified compact camera of unknown brand and model.

risks.risk: Camera does not power on or function; lens cap is on and no screen or buttons are demonstrated.
risks.proof: Video of the camera turning on, taking a photo, and recording video.

risks.risk: Missing accessories such as battery, charger, cables, memory card, or box.
risks.proof: Photo showing every item included in the sale.

risks.risk: Hidden damage such as lens scratches, fungus, LCD cracks, or sensor issues not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens glass, screen, and ports.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the camera being sold showing the model number, to resolve whether it is Nikon or Sony.
Video of the camera powering on, taking a photo, and recording video.
Photo of all accessories included (battery, charger, cables, memory card, box).
response.reason: Photos 0 and 1 show a Nikon Coolpix while photo 2 shows a Sony camera, so the item identity and model are unresolved; no price can be set without knowing which camera is for sale.
